au-albums.title: Another Mission Yet Again
au-albums.desc:
Another Mission Yet Again — ICT - DJ Lexo
The mission continues, the journey evolves, and the sound speaks for itself. Another Mission Yet Again is a new chapter in the ICT journey, brought to life by dj Lexo. Blending deep vibes, infectious rhythms, and a distinctive sonic identity, this album takes you on a musical journey filled with energy, emotion, and nonstop motion.
Every track represents another step forward, another story to tell, and another mission to conquer. Whether you're locked in with headphones or letting the music take over the atmosphere, this project is made to keep you moving and connected to the sound.
No shortcuts. No stopping. Just music, vision, and another mission yet again.

au-albums.title: Time (EP)
au-albums.desc:
Time is my debut 'EP' as Ekāy. It contains four songs and an intro/interlude. One of the songs contains a sample of Peggy Lee's legendary voice from the 1958 recording 'Fever', in my version titled (You Give Me) Fever. The 'EP' also includes a cover of Nina Simones sensual song 'I Put A Spell On You' where the acapella originates from the original 1965 recording. 

'Time' is a journey from ambient electronic music to electroswing and RnB-based electronic and discovers feelings about being weak to in context to the big universe and also being weak fore love and what it does to humans. Enjoy!
